messages:
maya: heads up — UX/ API question: can we support saving a query that encodes per-route model pins + a token ceiling and show an immediate quota/cost preview in the console?
ryan: yes we can, but need to agree on the shape: is this a `View` (savefull) or just a `Filter` with metadata?
ellie: prefer `views` conceptually — a saved set of visual state + runtime hints (pins, sample rate, quota). Filters feel too lightweight.
samir: main backend constraint: computing a reliable cost/ quota preview requires recent traffic histograms + model unit costs. We can approximate client-side but ops wants server-side calc for accuracy. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
josh: what about hybrid: UI shows instant approximation (client-est) and we call a lightweight backend `estimate` endpoint in the background for a precise preview? fails open if estimate times out.
lina: UX note — people want both absolute token burn and % of route quota used (for Dedicated). Preview should show both and a little color affordance (green/yellow/red).
maya: proposal for API payload (rough):
```json
POST /views
{
  "name": "High-cost-model-compare",
  "scope": [
    {"route_selector":"/api/chat/*","models":["redwood/gpt-6b-q4","redwood/gpt-6b-q8"]}
  ],
  "sample_rate": 0.1,
  "quota": {"tokens_per_month": 200000},
  "preview_options": {"target": "hosted_and_dedicated"}
}
```
ryan: I like that. Two API debates: (A) `scope` as route selectors vs explicit route ids, and (B) should `models` be an ordered list (for fallback) or single pin?
ellie: ordered list is important for rollouts (canary -> primary). We also need a compact way to express "all routes in a workspace" for shared views.
samir: ops: if scope is free-form selectors we need to compile selectors into route lists at save time and store the concrete route ids for cost calc. Selector compilation must be eventually consistent.
josh: rollout UX: when a saved view references multiple models, console should show a per-model delta card and the combined expected burn. Also show a telemetry-sample checkbox: "preview with telemetry sample set X".
lina: tiny accessibility/clarity ask: show sample set id + when it was last refreshed. Too many previews get stale.
maya: security question: saved views can be shared org-wide. Do we allow quota ceilings in a shared view? can that act as a soft guard or would it be misleading?
samir: enforcement is separate — quota on a view is advisory unless tied to reservation on Dedicated. We should label advisory vs enforceable.
ellie: SDK/ console contract: `POST /views` returns a `preview_id` and `estimate` object if available. Also returns `applied_route_ids` (list) so the UI is explicit about what was included.
josh: edge case: customer has dozens of routes; the `applied_route_ids` list could be huge. We should return a sampling summary (count + representative examples) and a pagination endpoint `/views/:id/applied_routes?page=` for full list.
maya: good call. Also we need telemetry gating for rollout: when saving a view with a model pin, can we trigger an automatic small-sample eval job and show a quality delta (BLEU/embedding drift) in the preview?
ryan: that's a longer feature but powerful. We should make it opt-in and async — UI shows "quality eval pending" and updates when done.
lina: deploy-bot FYI: new `estimate` endpoint landed on staging.
deploy-bot: [staging] POST /views/estimate deployed by @buildbot at 3276543222 :shipit:
samir: next steps for backend epic: 1) agree on `scope` compilation semantics, 2) implement `estimate` with histogram join, 3) add pagination for applied routes, 4) mark quota advisory vs enforced.
ellie: UX follow-ups: wireframes for save modal with cost badge + sample selector + share controls. I'll mock tomorrow.
maya: thanks — can we pick a decision owner for API shape? ryan volunteered in thread earlier. ryan: taking owner. I'll write a short ADR with the `scope` vs `explicit` tradeoffs and the sample response payload (estimate + preview_id + applied_route_summary).
josh: one more design note — when saving, if estimate > 50% of quota show a small warning and an action: "Create quota reservation" that links to Dedicated flow.
lina: +1
maya: great — tagging PMs and infra: @ellie @samir @ryan please sync tomorrow 11am.
end
